purpose: Structured, blank intake fields for the owner to supply evidence, positioning, and decisions into. Every field below is UNFILLED. No name, number, date, client, outcome, credential, product fact, health assertion, legal assertion, performance result, or media statistic has been invented anywhere in this file. Filling a field in this document does NOT by itself make anything verified, approved for public use, or active -- see docs/internal/mark-7-evidence-submission-guide.md for how a filled field moves toward the existing proof registry (docs/mark-5-tmi-content-model-and-proof-registry.json) and route completion gates (docs/mark-5-route-completion-specification.json).

designNote: Where the brief asks for a per-item field set repeated across several named concepts (e.g. Consulting's 7 service concepts, or a reusable candidate template like 'case-study candidate'), this file uses ONE intake row per concept/candidate slot, with a nested `templateFields` object holding that item's own sub-field set -- rather than exploding every sub-field into its own top-level row. This keeps the registry navigable while still representing every field the brief names.
